description: Create a project.faf for a project, making it instantly AI-readable. Returns the new file location and starting score. Accepts a path or bare project name (e.g. ~/Projects/my-app, my-app) and omitting it uses the current directory.

force.description: Overwrite existing project.faf if it exists

path.description: Project path or name. Smart resolution: "my-app" finds ~/Projects/my-app OR ~/Code/my-app. Full paths like ~/Projects/app or /Users/me/code/app work too. Omit to use current directory.

name: faf_init
